descriptionPlain:
At Distru, we’re always looking to connect with smart, motivated people who are passionate about shaping the future of the cannabis supply chain. Even if you don’t see an open role that fits your background today, we’d still love to hear from you. By joining our general application pool, you’ll be on our radar for future openings — and if we come across a unique opportunity or see a strong fit, we may reach out even before a role is officially posted. We believe the right person can help shape the role as much as the role shapes them, so if you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to explore the possibilities together.

descriptionPlain:
About Distru
Distru is the #1 ERP in the cannabis industry with $15B in sales processed through our platform. We've built a battle-tested ERP and B2B eCommerce platform that powers inventory, manufacturing, sales, and logistics, and we're now building AI infrastructure on top of it to give commercial businesses their all-in-one AI stack.
We're growing and profitable, with 5/5 stars on Glassdoor. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Poseidon Asset Management, and Village Global, who have funded companies such as Shopify, Cruise, HelloFresh, Facebook, Slack, and Opendoor.
Get to know the team, our culture and our full benefits at distru.com/careers!
The Role
AI is at an inflection point for enterprise use, and AI assistants like Claude, Codex, and Grok are seeing record adoption at work. We believe the system of record has never been more valuable for organizing the data AI acts on.
We started with our AI Order Agent, now rolled out across our customer base, which lets buyers submit orders from any source in any format. It's the first piece of a much bigger agentic ecosystem we’re building, and we're moving most of our engineering effort to AI-first work to build it.
You'll work directly with our Director of AI Engineering to own the technical buildout of our AI product suite, including:
Agentic harness: a multi-agent system that safely operates across a business's core tools (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, calendars, email, analytics, compliance systems)
MCP: our MCP that connects Distru to external AI harnesses
Context Layer: our context layer that ingests customer data, builds memories and profiles, and feeds back into our harness to create more personalized AI experiences for our customers
Evals: the eval suites that make our agents reliable in production
And more…
You’ll be working directly on the AI system from the ground up and make strong, opinionated calls on the agentic stack and where it goes next. The AI space moves fast and the specifics will change, so this technical vision is something you'll mold.
You'll report to the VP of Engineering and the Director of AI Engineering, and work closely with the rest of the product team, eng team, and our customers.
description:
About Distru

Distru is the #1 ERP in the cannabis industry with $15B in sales processed through our platform. We've built a battle-tested ERP and B2B eCommerce platform that powers inventory, manufacturing, sales, and logistics, and we're now building AI infrastructure on top of it to give commercial businesses their all-in-one AI stack.

We're growing and profitable, with 5/5 stars on Glassdoor. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Poseidon Asset Management, and Village Global, who have funded companies such as Shopify, Cruise, HelloFresh, Facebook, Slack, and Opendoor.

Get to know the team, our culture and our full benefits at distru.com/careers!

The Role

AI is at an inflection point for enterprise use, and AI assistants like Claude, Codex, and Grok are seeing record adoption at work. We believe the system of record has never been more valuable for organizing the data AI acts on.

We started with our AI Order Agent, now rolled out across our customer base, which lets buyers submit orders from any source in any format. It's the first piece of a much bigger agentic ecosystem we’re building, and we're moving most of our engineering effort to AI-first work to build it.

You'll work directly with our Director of AI Engineering to own the technical buildout of our AI product suite, including:

  • Agentic harness: a multi-agent system that safely operates across a business's core tools (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, calendars, email, analytics, compliance systems)
  • MCP: our MCP that connects Distru to external AI harnesses
  • Context Layer: our context layer that ingests customer data, builds memories and profiles, and feeds back into our harness to create more personalized AI experiences for our customers
  • Evals: the eval suites that make our agents reliable in production
  • And more…

You’ll be working directly on the AI system from the ground up and make strong, opinionated calls on the agentic stack and where it goes next. The AI space moves fast and the specifics will change, so this technical vision is something you'll mold.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering and the Director of AI Engineering, and work closely with the rest of the product team, eng team, and our customers.

lists.content:
Agentic engineering

  • Architect and build a production multi-agent system that can safely take actions across Distru and our customer’s core systems
  • Iterate and maintain the MCP that connects Distru to Claude & Codex.
  • Own reliability, observability, and durable execution end to end. The harness takes real actions on customers' data, so the bar is high.
  • Write evals to improve our agentic systems from real customer use cases
  • Build a unified data system that pulls data from multiple sources into a singular data layer that can be exposed to Claude & Codex via an MCP
  • Build a contextual memory system that ingests our customers' data and improves how our agents work for them

    • AI research & experimentation

  • Keep pace with the latest agentic frameworks, harnesses, toolkits, models, and bring in better approaches as they emerge
  • Rapidly prototype new ideas to present to our team and our customers

    • Engineering workflow

  • Build hands-on with Claude Code and similar tools as part of your own workflow
  • Improve our agentic coding workflow and bring new discoveries to the team

lists.text: What success looks like at 6 months
lists.content:
• You've shipped core improvements to our harness in production that our customers use daily, with clear observability and iteration for improvement
  • You’ve shipped and iterated on many MCP tools and improvements
  • Every agent you own has an eval suite and observability, so the team catches regressions before customers do
  • You own a part of the agentic stack and are the go-to person for it across the company
  • You’ve built prototypes on how our agentic infrastructure can improve (i.e. a new way to retrieve memories, an agentic onboarding process for our customers)

AI fluency

For every AI role, we look for three things:

  • Tool fluency: you build with Claude Code or similar every day, you've built your own skills, agents, or workflows, and you can explain why your setup looks the way it does.
  • Workflow fluency: you write evals before you trust a prompt, and you know when a model is the wrong tool and plain code is the right one.
  • Build fluency: you've put agents in front of real users, with guardrails, observability, and a way to roll back.

    • You use AI tools daily and can tell us specifically where your fluency is strong and where you're still building it.

    Must have

  • 5+ years in full-stack development, ideally on B2B SaaS applications
  • Multi-agent harnesses: hands-on experience building multi-agent harnesses in production, not just prototypes or personal projects
  • MCPs: you've built MCPs that are used in production
  • Production systems: a strong grasp of reliability, observability, permissions, and safe workflow execution
  • Product and engineering: you've operated as both, and you're comfortable owning scoping and decisions, not just implementation
  • Modern stack: proficiency in React, TypeScript, Node, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and LangGraph, and you pick up new tools and frameworks quickly
  • Startup agility: you've worked at an early-stage startup (under 20 engineers) and operated well in ambiguous, unstructured environments
  • Low ego: you're team-first and measure success by what shipped and whether it worked, not by internal politics
  • Clear communication: you raise concerns and propose solutions before being asked

    • Strong signal

  • Background building supply chain, ERP, CRM, B2B marketplace, or accounting software
  • UX design experience
  • Agentic systems work beyond the must-haves, such as evaluation frameworks or agent-to-agent protocols
  • Experience using Claude Code (or similar) to build products on your own
  • Cannabis industry experience

• We love building with AI. Trying new models the week they drop, building agents for fun, and forming strong opinions on what works. We invest in it with company-wide AI growth with classes and workshops, AI demo days, AI hackathons, and access to best-in-class models and tools.
  • Taste in building. A lot of this role comes down to knowing what to build, what to cut, and what a great agentic experience feels like for the user.
  • We stay close to the customer. You'll talk to customers and our GTM team directly, not through a chain of tickets.
  • You'll build on what we've learned. You'll have access to the team's combined AI knowledge and the processes and skills we've built.

    • For the full picture of our culture and who thrives here, see distru.com/careers.

lists.content:
Product execution

  • Gather customer feedback directly and through CS and sales, then deconstruct it into system-level AI features that benefit the wider user base and scale with future additions
  • Prioritize the roadmap and timeline around the work with the most revenue impact
  • Write PRDs with thoughtful UX designs, ready for the engineering team to execute on

    • Product ownership

  • Own features from inception to release, iteration, and continued maintenance
  • Define and measure the success of every feature you're responsible for. You are the CEO of every feature you touch.
  • Own the knowledge base, MCP docs, and go-to-market content for your features, and enable marketing and sales on everything you ship

    • Cross-functional leadership

  • Work closely with engineering, GTM, sales, and CS. You're the bridge that pulls insights from every department together and keeps the product moving.

lists.text: What success looks like at 6 months
lists.content:
• You've shipped at least one AI-native feature to production with measurable user adoption
  • The product team and engineers trust you to write well-thought-through PRDs
  • You own a part of the Distru product and are the go-to person for it across the company

AI fluency

For every AI role, we look for three things:

  • Tool fluency: your setup is AI-forward and you have opinions on which tools to use (and not use). You go beyond prompting ChatGPT or Claude and have built your own skills, agents, or workflows.
  • Workflow fluency: you can break a PM process into human steps, AI steps, and hybrid steps, and explain what you chose to automate, what you kept human, and why.
  • Build fluency: you've shipped AI features that hold up in the real world, with nuanced workflows, different user personas, and users who aren't AI fluent. You know when AI feels natural versus forced, and you can defend the calls you made.

    • You use AI tools daily and can tell us specifically where your fluency is strong and where you're still building it.

    Must have

  • 3+ years in product management
  • Product ownership: you've owned at least one significant AI feature or product end to end, from an ambiguous problem statement through launch and iteration, with measurable outcomes
  • UX proficiency: you've created intuitive products that abstract away complexity for the user, without the need for a designer
  • Technical fluency: you're comfortable with engineering concepts such as SQL, telemetry, agentic harnesses, subagents, and RAG
  • Clear communication: you convey your thinking briefly and clearly
  • Tooling: experience with product management tooling (Notion, Miro, Claude, Hotjar, LangSmith, etc.)

    • Strong signal

  • Background in supply chain, ERP, CRM, B2B marketplaces, or accounting
  • Experience using Claude Code (or similar coding tools) to build products on your own
  • Familiarity with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Experience in early-stage startups (0–50 headcount)

• We love building with AI. Trying new models the week they drop, building agents for fun, and forming strong opinions on what works. We invest in it with company-wide AI growth with classes and workshops, AI demo days, AI hackathons, and access to best-in-class models and tools.
  • We ship fast. We expect PMs to be comfortable with the pace of a startup.
  • We care about edge cases and details. Our customers' SOPs are nuanced, and details matter when you're handling their inventory and finances.
  • You'll build on what we've learned. You'll have access to the team's combined AI knowledge and the processes and skills we've built.

    • For the full picture of our culture and who thrives here, see distru.com/careers.

We've built a battle-tested ERP and B2B eCommerce platform that powers inventory, manufacturing, sales, and logistics, and we're now building AI infrastructure on top of it to give commercial businesses their all-in-one AI stack.
We're growing and profitable, with 5/5 stars on Glassdoor. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Poseidon Asset Management, and Village Global, who have funded companies such as Shopify, Cruise, HelloFresh, Facebook, Slack, and Opendoor.
Get to know the team, our culture and our full benefits at distru.com/careers!
The Role
AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT are seeing record adoption at work, and they're only as useful as the data they can reach. For our customers, that data lives in Distru. We believe the system of record has never been more valuable, so we're building Distru headless-first: unified access to ERP data, deep MCP and AI assistant integrations, agents embedded in Distru, and a seamless experience between the ERP and the AI tools our customers already use.
You'll own and evolve Distru's AI product suite, including:
MCP: connect AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT directly to Distru data
Agent Builder: build agents that run inside Distru, with workflow support for multi-step processes
Unified Data Engine: unify ERP and business data into one layer that AI can query and act on
And more…
We're in the early stages, so you'll define the product from the ground up and make strong, opinionated calls on what we build and where it goes next. The AI space moves fast and the specifics will change, so this vision is something you'll mold. You'll report to the executive team and work closely with engineering, design, GTM, and customer success.

additionalPlain:
Benefits
Our careers page is the best way to get to know us: the full benefits, our yearly offsites, who thrives here, and what the team says about working at Distru.

Here are a few highlights (exact benefits vary by country and employment type):
Fully remote across 4 continents
Employee-friendly option terms: after 2 years, a 10-year window to exercise if you leave
18 days PTO + 11 holidays (sick days don't count toward PTO)
Medical, dental, vision + 401(k) for US employees
The best AI tools available and a generous AI stipend for everything else
Yearly in-person team offsites
Interview process
Application questions: three short questions on something you've built with AI, an AI capability you've shipped, and the product teams you've led
Leadership interview (60 min): your background, how you lead, hire, and manage product teams, and a briefing on the role
AI product-market fit (60 min): your view of AI product-market fit for Distru, plus a show and tell of products and mockups you've built
Co-building session (90 min): build a working prototype of a feature live with AI, alongside our design and product team
Technical leadership (60 min): how you work with engineering, what makes an MCP and headless suite defensible, and how product improves agents over time
Take-home: Headless AI Product Suite (4–8 hours, then a 60 min presentation): define Distru's headless AI product suite and present it live
Meet the team (four 45 min calls): calls with both co-founders, a reverse AMA with GTM, and an AMA with the product team
References and offer
Distru was formed by an environment of mutual respect and trust made up by people working together without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our team members is critical to our success and we proactively strive to recruit, develop and retain the best and brightest people from the most diverse candidate pools we can find all over the world.

lists.content:
Product strategy

  • Deliver a quarterly strategy review to the exec team: market landscape, ERP and AI sequencing, a 1-year roadmap, metrics, and resourcing asks
  • Own the product timeline and keep the company and technical teams aligned on it
  • Shape our data infrastructure (StarRocks, BigQuery, Postgres) with engineering so it serves internal and external AI use cases

    • AI vision and evangelism

  • Track new models, AI tools, and competitor moves, and turn them into a point of view on where Distru should play next
  • Find product-market fit for our AI products and size the new markets AI opens up, testing bets with customers before we commit the roadmap
  • Evangelize our AI vision inside and outside the company: rally the team, equip GTM with the story, and show customers and the industry what an AI-first ERP can do

    • Team leadership

  • Own the product hiring pipeline, set the hiring bar, and find creative ways to bring in top talent
  • Manage and coach the product team, including hard feedback, performance plans, and exits when needed
  • Set PRD standards, review PRDs, designs, and mockups, and lead the team's adoption of AI-first product processes

    • Cross-functional leadership

  • Set the operating cadence with engineering: planning, roadmap reviews, and a clear split where product owns the what and engineering owns the how
  • Work with GTM on launches, feature enablement, and AI-forward content, and make sure our MCP and API docs and knowledge base are high quality
  • Run the feedback loop from customers, CS, and Sales, build relationships with key customers, and track feature adoption in a way the whole company can see

lists.text: What success looks like at 6 months
lists.content:
• You've run your first quarterly strategy review, and the exec team has signed off on a 1-year roadmap tied to revenue targets
  • You've made your first product hires, at a hiring bar you've set and written down
  • You've shipped a core piece of the headless AI suite, and its adoption and revenue impact are tracked in a dashboard the whole company uses

AI fluency

For every AI role, we look for three things:

  • Tool fluency: you personally build with AI tools. You go beyond prompting and have built your own skills, agents, workflows, or prototypes.
  • Process fluency: you've set AI-first processes for a product team, and you have a point of view on how to evaluate AI fluency when hiring a PM.
  • Build fluency: you know how to evaluate an AI workflow in production, with evals, observability, and feedback loops that make agents better over time.

    • You use AI tools daily and can tell us specifically where your fluency is strong and where you're still building it.

    Must have

  • 10+ years in product management, including 4+ leading product teams
  • Product leadership: you've built and run a product org, including hiring, coaching, and making hard people calls, and you've led a product into new markets or major new product directions
  • AI products in production: you've built and shipped AI product lines such as MCPs, Agent Builders, Workflows, Copilots, etc… that are used in production
  • Technical depth: you know the modern SaaS and AI stack, including infrastructure, data, AI models, and full-stack development, and the production concerns that come with it: reliability, observability, permissions, and durable workflow execution
  • Outcome orientation: you measure the impact of product decisions by their revenue impact
  • Hands-on: you still do the work: PRDs, tools, details. You can sit with engineers without translating through a layer

    • Strong signal

  • Experience in ERP, accounting, cannabis, or supply chain software
  • You've taken an AI product from zero to revenue
  • You've led product at a B2B SaaS company at a similar stage
  • You've been a founder

• We love building with AI. Trying new models the week they drop, building agents for fun, and forming strong opinions on what works. We invest in it with company-wide AI growth with classes and workshops, AI demo days, AI hackathons, and access to best-in-class models and tools.
  • Product owns outcomes, not output. You measure product by adoption and revenue, and you hold the team to the same bar.
  • Taste and conviction beat consensus. You make opinionated calls on what we build, and you grow that taste across the product team.
  • Product owns the what, engineering owns the how. You hold a high technical bar without doing engineering's job.
  • You'll build on what we've learned. You'll have access to the team's combined AI knowledge and the processes and skills we've built.

    • For the full picture of our culture and who thrives here, see distru.com/careers.
